title: Charlotte Pike: answering the phone
purpose: The newest Nashville advisor's page on how the phone is answered there; the bright spot in a thin folder.
facts: Greeting: company name, shop, own name.

Five steps: name and number read back; car and problem with one extra question; price from the price list with a time attached (example: brake inspection 49.95 and a time tomorrow at 7:30); two times offered; booking read back.
With a customer present: answer, take name and number, call back within the hour.
The steps are the scorecard's checks (greeting, name_and_number, need_discovery, price_with_next_step, offered_time, asked_for_booking, recap).
Juniors cannot publish: written by slot 24, published by slot 2 at T-2 months.
Near-duplicate of how-to/taking-a-call.md in subject; they agree.

list_items.item: Their name, and "is this the best number for you?" Read the number back.
The car: year, make, model. And what it is doing, in their words. One more question than feels necessary.
If they ask a price, give it from the price list with a time attached: "A brake inspection is $49.95, and I could get you in tomorrow at 7:30."
Offer two times. Not "when would you like to come in".
Say the booking back: day, time, Charlotte Pike, what we are doing.

notes_for_russian_writer: Greeting «Ермак-Сервис на Технической, Камила, здравствуйте». Kazan is an hour behind Ulyanovsk.
